claims.text: Prometheus is a monitoring system that reads applications' metrics over HTTP in a plain-text, line-oriented format where each metric value (sample) sits on its own line; # HELP/# TYPE lines carry no value.
claims.source_hint: Prometheus docs: Overview; Instrumenting / Exposition formats (text-based format)

claims.text: From stage-2 DonHang.Api uses prometheus-net.AspNetCore (pinned 8.2.1 in Directory.Packages.props) and `using Prometheus;` in Program.cs.

app.UseHttpMetrics() is middleware that measures requests passing through the pipeline (count by status code/method, duration) and updates in-memory metrics such as http_requests_received_total; requests to /metrics itself are not counted.
claims.source_hint: prometheus-net README: ASP.NET Core HTTP request metrics (UseHttpMetrics)

claims.text: app.MapMetrics() maps an endpoint at /metrics (default path); a GET /metrics gets the current value of every registered metric as text; the API itself sends metrics nowhere (pull model).
claims.source_hint: prometheus-net README: ASP.NET Core exporter middleware (MapMetrics); Prometheus docs: Overview (pull model)

claims.text: /metrics returns only the value at the moment of the request, not a history; two calls give two snapshots and keeping values over time is the job of the program that asks.
claims.source_hint: Prometheus docs: Exposition formats (one value per sample line, optional timestamp); Overview (Prometheus stores the time series)

claims.text: Text format: each sample line is metric_name{label="value",...} value; a # HELP line gives a free-text description, a # TYPE line names the metric's type (here counter, a value that only goes up).
claims.source_hint: Prometheus docs: Exposition formats, text-based format (HELP, TYPE, sample lines)

claims.text: http_requests_received_total counts requests processed by the ASP.NET Core pipeline, one line per combination of label values; labels at stage-2: code, method, controller, action, endpoint (controller/action/endpoint name the route).
claims.source_hint: outputs/stage-2/scripts/devops/metrics-endpoint.txt (HELP text and sample lines); prometheus-net README: HTTP request metrics labels

claims.text: At stage-2 Caddy's :8080 site forwards only /api/v1/*, /api/v2/* and /openapi/* to api:8080; a path with no rule of its own, such as /metrics, falls to the final handle { file_server } and gets 404 when no such file exists.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-2: Caddyfile :8080 route; outputs/stage-2/scripts/devops/metrics-endpoint.txt (last line -> 404); Caddy docs: file_server (404 for missing file)

claims.text: Program.cs@stage-2:95-118: UseHttpMetrics() is registered first, before RequestLoggingMiddleware and ExceptionHandlingMiddleware; MapMetrics() comes after MapOpenApi().
Because UseHttpMetrics runs first, it records the status after later middleware returns, so a request that threw is counted with the 500 that ExceptionHandlingMiddleware wrote.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-2: Program.cs:95-99 comment; ASP.NET Core docs: Middleware order; prometheus-net README (status code recorded after next)

claims.text: In the lab box, localhost:8080 is Caddy (the web service shares the lab box's network namespace) and api:8080 is the API on the donhang Docker network; /metrics is not reachable from the laptop because the API's port is not published.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-2: docker-compose.yml (web network_mode service:lab, api no ports); devops.l1.reverse-proxy-basics

claims.text: scripts/devops/metrics-endpoint.sh output: 200 and 404 for products/1 and /999 through Caddy, HELP/TYPE lines and two http_requests_received_total lines differing only in code, then 404 for /metrics through Caddy.
Try it: running the script twice, each of the two http_requests_received_total values is one higher in the second run (each run sends one request answered 200 and one answered 404).
claims.source_hint: scripts/devops/metrics-endpoint.sh @ stage-2 lines 8-9; live run 2026-09-29 (2 and 1 after runs)

claims.text: One metric name with a method label keeps a separate number per method (e.g. method="POST" line appears after creating an order), instead of separate metric names.
claims.source_hint: Prometheus docs: Data model (labels); Naming (use labels, not names, for dimensions)
